_comment: Settings for suite_gen_inhibit.py (bench and emulated). One copy per machine, outside git; every <...> is a local path or name. The WiCAN SSID is never put here: the suite reads it from bench_holder. Keys the core reads: runs_root, bench_holder, bench_lock_log, canmain_check, hosts, esptool, wallclock_patterns (shared/bench/README.md). bench_lock_log puts the bench lock on that log; without it the Holder line of bench_holder is the lock, as before the cutover (shared/bench/SPEC.md (shared/main), section 7). Serial devices are named by their USB IDs, never a COM or tty name (DEVICES-SPEC S1, Linux only): esptool.device is the X2's, wican.usb_device the WiCAN's; the suite hands both to the tools as GI_X2_DEVICE and GI_WICAN_DEVICE. Serial numbers are bench identifiers: local settings only.

canmain_check.reason: <why this probe shows canmain down on this bench>

argv: <the python of ESP-IDF v5.4.2's python env, whose esptool is 4.13.0>

chip.mac: <the X2's MAC, as esptool chip_id prints it>

gi_commit: <the commit in the images' app descriptor, character for character: git's short form when they were built, which is 8 hex digits in this repo since 2026-11 (7 before); the suite compares it exactly, so a shorter or longer prefix of the same commit is refused as 'code is not identifiable'. The bench run looks for an emulated run on the same string, so give both runs the same one>
gi_can1_termination: <where the CAN1 terminators are, as read on the bench by a person; NONODE's --termination>
x2_pin_dir: <folder holding <pin>/<image>/<file> for x2_pin.json, e.g. <reverse-it>/projects/vtrux/notes/artifacts/gen-inhibit/x2_pin; filled by x2_pin.py install. Only where the files are: their bytes and the X2's identities are the committed pin's, and the old x2_images setting is refused>
_comment_serial_port: No serial_port: the interposer's bench_identify reads settings.serial_port, and the suite hands it a copy of these settings with serial_port set to the X2's by-id path, resolved from esptool.device (recorded in the identify step's serial_device_bench_identify.txt).
